scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter @zannen/* build && bash scripts/build-plugin.sh zannen-debugger && cargo build --workspace --release
scripts.build:assets: node scripts/gen-installer-assets.mjs && swift scripts/gen-themed-icons.swift branding/ZannenToolbox图标-暗色模式.png branding/ZannenToolbox图标-亮色模式.png branding && cd app-shell && pnpm exec tauri icon ../branding/icon-dark.png && cp ../branding/icon-dark-512.png ../branding/icon-light-512.png src-tauri/icons/ && pnpm exec tauri icon ../branding/installer-dark.png -o /tmp/zannen-installer-icons && cp /tmp/zannen-installer-icons/icon.ico src-tauri/installer/installer.ico
